name: Run, Foxxy, run!
author: Melai-melai
description:
Help the fox run to the forest and overcome all obstacles. You control a fox that can jump over obstacles. The game has 3 difficulty levels. To win, you need to collect a certain number of apples and go the distance. But time is limited. 
Controls:
Left Arrow - Turn left
Right Arrow - Turn right
Space - Jump
This is my first Unity game. I hope it will delight you. Thank you for the attention.
Good luck!
